card.name: Opening bracket before generic drug name
card.fires_on: An opening parenthesis right after a brand drug name, just before the generic name, as in a list of contrast agents. It also fires on 'of' or 'and' just before a drug name.

modes.label: Parenthesis before generic name
modes.description: The '(' after a brand name where the generic name follows.

modes.label: Linking word before drug name
modes.description: 'of' or 'and' just before a drug name in dosing or retention text.
